def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    cross_r = next(r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == 9 for v in row))
    cross_c = next(c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == 9 for r in range(h)))
    dr, dc = cross_r + 1, cross_c + 1
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            value = grid[r][c]
            if value in (7, 9):
                continue
            other_r = r + dr if r < cross_r else r - dr
            other_c = c + dc if c < cross_c else c - dc
            for rr, cc in ((other_r, c), (r, other_c), (other_r, other_c)):
                if 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w and out[rr][cc] != 9:
                    out[rr][cc] = value
    return out
PY
